rounds.text: All E Technologies Ltd is currently priced at a significant discount relative to its fundamental performance, trading at a P/E of 12.9x [E1] compared to a sector benchmark of -203.71x [E6]. The company demonstrates consistent operational efficiency, maintaining a 5-year median return on equity of 17% [E22] and a robust ROCE of 20.7% [E12], which comfortably exceeds the sector median of 12.1% [E71]. This profitability is supported by a strong 5-year compounded profit growth rate of 28% [E17], significantly outpacing the sector median growth of 10.9% [E69]. The current valuation is further underscored by a P/B ratio of 1.66x [E7], which is substantially lower than the sector benchmark of 7.35x [E7]. Conceded: the stock is currently trading near its 52-week low [E5] and has experienced a 5% decline in trailing twelve-month profit growth [E19]. Despite this recent deceleration, the company is beginning to outperform expectations, with profit growth currently exceeding 1-year price growth by 56% [E53].
